title: claim-audit-record/v1
description: One adjudicated (sentence, citation) pair in a project's claim-faithfulness audit (evidence/claim-faithfulness-audit-[date].ndjson). Produced by the verify-claim-faithfulness agent (.claude/agents/verify-claim-faithfulness.md) and scholar-citation Step V-3.5. EVERY adjudicated claim gets a record, including CLAIM-VERIFIED. Validated by scripts/gates/check-claim-audit-consistency.sh.

claim_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the normalized manuscript sentence (lowercase, HTML comments stripped, whitespace collapsed). Used by evidence-anchor-check.sh --phase 11-entry to detect claims rewritten after audit.

anchor_refs.description: anchor_ids from evidence/claim-anchors.ndjson consulted for this claim. REQUIRED (non-empty) when the audited sentence carries <!--ev:--> tags; empty plus unmatched_reason otherwise.

unmatched_reason.description: Why anchor_refs is empty (e.g. 'no write-time anchor exists for this claim').

evidence_quote.description: VERBATIM source passage bearing on this sub-claim. Required for SUPPORTED and CONTRADICTED verdicts (enforced by check-claim-audit-consistency.sh).

access_tier_max.description: Strongest tier reached across sub-claims. Precision rule: CLAIM-UNSUPPORTED requires T0/T1/T2 — abstract-only absence is CLAIM-NOT-CHECKABLE.
